2: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, a very sufficient help in troubles.
3: Therefore we will not fear though the earth change, and though the mountains totter into the ⌞midst⌟ of the sea,
4: though its waters roar and foam, though mountains shake with its surging water. Selah
5: There is a river whose streams gladden the city of God, the holiest of the dwellings of the Most High.
6: God is in the midst of her; she will not be made to totter. God will help her ⌞at daybreak⌟.
7: Nations roar, kingdoms shake; he utters his voice, the earth melts.
8: Yahweh of hosts is with us; our high stronghold is the God of Jacob. Selah
9: Come, see the works of Yahweh, who has placed desolations on the earth.
10: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and cuts off the spear. The wagons of war he burns with fire.
11: Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations; I will be exalted in the earth.
12: Yahweh of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our high stronghold.
